summary: All 10 must requirements from spec.json and identified design risks are implemented, documented, and validated by the test suite with 31 passing tests and zero failures reported in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R1: Auto-generated unique code shortening endpoint (POST /shorten)
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Endpoints/LinkEndpoints.cs (MapPost /shorten) and src/App/Services/LinkService.cs (CreateShortLinkAsync); verified by tests in tests/ShortenEndpointTests.cs (R1_Shorten_ReturnsCreatedWithCode, R1_Shorten_DifferentUrls_ReceiveDistinctGeneratedCodes) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R2: Custom unique alias support and collision rejection (HTTP 409)
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Services/LinkService.cs (CreateShortLinkAsync) and src/App/Services/CodeGeneratorService.cs (ValidateCustomAlias); verified by tests in tests/ShortenEndpointTests.cs (R2_Shorten_WithCustomAlias_ReturnsCreatedWithSpecifiedCode, R2_Shorten_DuplicateCustomAlias_ReturnsConflict409) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R3: Redirection with HTTP 307 and click tracking (GET /{code})
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Endpoints/LinkEndpoints.cs (MapGet /{code}) and src/App/Services/LinkService.cs (GetRedirectAsync); verified by tests in tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs (R3_Redirect_ActiveCode_Returns307TemporaryRedirectWithLocation, R3_Redirect_NonExistentCode_ReturnsNotFound404, R3_Redirect_IncrementsClickCountAndUpdatesLastVisitedAt) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R4: Optional link expiration enforcement (HTTP 404 upon expiry)
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Services/LinkService.cs (GetRedirectAsync checking ExpiresAt <= DateTime.UtcNow); verified by tests in tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs (R4_Shorten_WithExpiration_StoresExpirationTimestamp, R4_Redirect_ExpiredLink_ReturnsNotFound404AndDoesNotIncrementClicks) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R5: Analytics endpoint returning clicks and timestamps (GET /analytics/{code})
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Endpoints/LinkEndpoints.cs (MapGet /analytics/{code}) and src/App/Services/LinkService.cs (GetAnalyticsAsync); verified by tests in tests/AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs (R5_Analytics_NewLink_ReturnsZeroClicksAndNullLastVisited, R5_Analytics_AfterVisit_ReturnsUpdatedClicksAndLastVisitedTimestamp, R5_Analytics_NonExistentCode_ReturnsNotFound404) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R6: Service and database health check endpoint (GET /health)
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Endpoints/LinkEndpoints.cs (MapGet /health checking CanConnectAsync); verified by tests in tests/AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs (R6_Health_WhenOperational_ReturnsOk200, R6_Health_WhenDatastoreUnavailable_ReturnsServiceUnavailable503) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R7: SSRF prevention and unsafe protocol validation
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Services/UrlValidationService.cs (ValidateUrlAsync, IsPrivateOrRestricted); verified by tests in tests/ShortenEndpointTests.cs (R7_Shorten_NonHttpScheme_ReturnsBadRequest400, R7_Shorten_PrivateOrLoopbackIp_ReturnsBadRequest400, R7_Shorten_DomainResolvingToPrivateIp_ReturnsBadRequest400) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R8: Per-client IP rate limiting on link creation (HTTP 429 with Retry-After)
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Middleware/RateLimitingConfiguration.cs (AddShortenRateLimiter, ResolveClientIp) and src/App/Endpoints/LinkEndpoints.cs; verified by tests in tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs (R8_RateLimiting_WithinThreshold_ReturnsCreated201, R8_RateLimiting_ExceedingThreshold_ReturnsTooManyRequests429WithRetryAfter) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R9: Data persistence across application restarts
checklist.evidence: Implemented in src/App/Data/AppDbContext.cs and src/App/Program.cs (persistent SQLite database configuration); verified by tests in tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs (R9_Persistence_SurvivesServiceRestart) passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: R10: Comprehensive automated tests and root README documentation
checklist.evidence: README.md provides complete setup, API contracts, and run instructions; 31 automated tests across tests/ShortenEndpointTests.cs, tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs, tests/AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs, and tests/RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs confirmed passing in verify_report.json.

checklist.item: Risk: SQLite write concurrency lock contention
checklist.evidence: Mitigated via SQLite WAL pragma execution in src/App/Program.cs ('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;') and connection string options in src/App/appsettings.json.

checklist.item: Risk: DNS rebinding and SSRF target circumvention
checklist.evidence: Mitigated via pre-shorten DNS check in src/App/Services/UrlValidationService.cs and client redirection model (HTTP 307) avoiding server-side content fetching.
